status: prospective T001 contract; not a T002 study freeze or authorization to collect

selected_timing_build.cxx_flags: -O3 -DNDEBUG; actual full flags/compiler/linkage and probe state pending T002
selected_timing_build.reason: User-facing optimized baseline, unlike Debug-only overhead; use existing output directory in place, no new worktree/build pair. Old Release bytes are explicitly ineligible; T002 reconfigures/builds and qualifies current source before any sample. Debug is preparation/correctness/diagnostic only, never pooled.
selected_timing_build.source_symbol_probe_strategy: pending_T002; perf policy may prevent sampling. Source-confirm tool capability/overhead or bounded opt-in probe with trace-OFF build; a different build mode requires prospective amendment, not silently pooling timings.

selected_platform_scope.session: native X11, owned process/window on current Intel Mesa renderer
selected_platform_scope.gpu_choice: Intel UHD/TGL Mesa; NVIDIA present but not selected
selected_platform_scope.input_theme_style: Qt defaults as source-confirmed by T002; preserve current IBus/XMODIFIERS profile in owned namespaces, no GNOME/IBus memory-safety claim

tessellation.verification: T002 records exact effective property/settings and triangle counts; no quality lowering

selected_platform_scope.driver_renderer_library_realization: pending_T002; do not infer realized hardware from a label
selected_platform_scope.other_platforms: unqualified; no Wayland/NVIDIA/softwareGL or Windows/macOS extrapolation

fixed_schedule.minimum_valid_coverage: 5/5 eligible attempts per nonpaired cell; 5/5 complete eligible matched pairs per Q01 cell, with successful unpooled warmups
fixed_schedule.nonreplacement: No invalid/missing/excluded/timeout row is replenished; coverage failure yields inconclusive/stop, never continue until good rows. Recovery is a separate prospectively frozen complete schedule with no replacement/pooling of originals.
fixed_schedule.extension: A 20-pair comparison, if selected, requires a new freeze before samples; exactly10AB/10BA seeded order, all20pairs required. It never augments/pools the screening distribution.
fixed_schedule.between_cell_order: seeded within-stream permutation; five round-robin blocks rotate/reverse cell order, one attempt/pair per cell per block; task/stream order linear. No cell-major five-attempt batches.
fixed_schedule.scope_rationale: Focused operation/scale/endpoints only, not a full fixture×operation×platform×build factorial. GUI sequences record separate segment endpoints in one scheduled attempt where declared; App-only contexts remain separate cells. Full schedule stops at resource caps without selective completion.

profile_rule.limit: max2 separate traced processes per stream total, not per cell
profile_rule.timing_use: descriptive attribution only, never pooled with untraced latency
profile_rule.changes: A different posthoc diagnostic is labeled posthoc and separately identified; it cannot replace fixed targets or supply an acceptance tail.

process_reset.default: fresh owned process and profile per attempt/QR arm; fresh canonical work copy, verified recipe precursor and baseline semantic identity
process_reset.qr_order: fixed seeded schedule in attempts; arms sequential, never concurrent; identical precursor/warmups/cache; actual method/settings verified each arm and restored at final exit
process_reset.same_process_exception: No same-process QR in v1. Requires prospective amendment and demonstrated complete solver/cache/allocator/settings reset.
process_reset.user_site: mask only user Python site in an owned mount namespace if needed; verify actual mapped modules. Do not uninstall/modify user packages.
process_reset.operator_session: Do not use --single-instance, global desktop capture, live operator document or preferences. Never kill unrelated processes; pause collection when unrelated FreeCAD/build/test activity fails eligibility.

cache_policy.default: fresh process, no global kernel cache drop; OS page cache uncontrolled/recorded
cache_policy.fixture_copy: new owned work copy per attempt (not falsely called OS-cold); no independent drive cache claim
cache_policy.warm_regime: v1 has one separate untimed warmup process per cell/QR arm; no additional in-process per-attempt warmup. Fresh process is not OS-cold or solver-cold: baseline restore/reset may populate solver state and must be identical, qualified and recorded. A different warm-process regime requires a prospective amendment.
cache_policy.power_governor: record and hold actual AC/governor/profile; do not alter global settings

host_eligibility.preflight_scope: 10-second quiet/admission window before each cell warmup; host trace remains continuous across round-robin blocks; each attempt rechecks the immediately preceding2s admission context and full-attempt host record. Owned startup/reset CPU is not non-owned contention.
required: CPU utilization from proc counters, normalized by logical CPU count; owned-tree CPU accounted separately where measurable
memory PSI full; CPU governor/AC state
unrelated build/test/benchmark activity and additional FreeCAD activity
host_eligibility.missing: Missing optional GPU/frequency/thermal sensors explicitly null. Missing required Linux admission metrics or unqualified sampling resolution blocks eligibility until prospectively resolved, not zero-filled.
host_eligibility.during_attempt: threshold/identity/clock breaches mark the scheduled attempt retained/ineligible, making its cell inconclusive under5/5. Short operations use fixed pre/post quiet windows and label coarse host attribution; load alone never proves cause.
host_eligibility.active_operator: Never terminate/modify operator activity to satisfy a quiet gate; wait or report eligibility limitation.

metrics.wall_clock: monotonic_ns, exact operation endpoints from manifest; App return and correct frame separate
metrics.cpu: owned process-tree user/system CPU plus context switches/I/O when source-confirmed
metrics.memory: baseline immediately after reset/settle; whole-process high-water RSS separately from any T002-qualified operation-local peak; post-operation RSS at fixed2s quiescent point; logical transient/retained data and GPU measurements where available. Never subtract RSS high-water as retained memory or assume reclamation.
metrics.trace_overlap: inclusive spans and concurrent intervals explicitly defined; no summed nested QR/kernel/recompute/tree/render totals or double-counted candidate saving
metrics.frame_events: input timestamps/order, intended/accepted/coalesced/drop/render/readback/presentation identity/count; fixed-rate60Hz and completion-gated cells separate; source-qualified witness or honest narrower endpoint only

solid_checks: valid single solid and expected topology class or intentional-change map
persistent first-hole/corner geometric reference witnesses, not volume alone
transactions/undo/redo/save-reopen and tree observer/lifetime/eventual completion as applicable
oracle_contract.rank: Both J/JT ranks, ordered diagnostic IDs and DoF must match independent rank(J)=rank(JT)=remaining J parameter count / analytic reduced-rank and geometry oracles. T002 binds native parameter bookkeeping and independent non-QR matrix reference before any paired study. Near-tangent analytic condition is recorded; disagreement rejects that fixture/configuration, never tune solver tolerance.
oracle_contract.assembly: full post-reopen graph/connector/status/allowed-motion oracle pending T002; T001 generic roundtrip alone is not joint solver qualification
oracle_contract.failures: oracle mismatch or corrupt output stops the cell/stream and excludes timing interpretation while retaining evidence; no faster-but-wrong acceptance

resource_bounds.build_growth_scope: all in-place build plus compiler-cache growth combined; no unreserved alternate build
resource_bounds.resource_admission: Before build, free>=25GiB floor+6GiB remaining build/cache growth+4GiB remaining private reservation+64MiB remaining publication. Before study freeze after build: free>=floor+max(0,4GiB-retained_private)+max(0,64MiB-retained_public); reserve all remaining study maxima, not merely the next cell. T002 verifies full 390-row+profile/telemetry/cleanup duration estimate<=4h and each stream<=30min or requires prospective amendment BEFORE launch.
resource_bounds.guard: check available bytes and owned-output sizes before each cell/profile/build step; hard stop before crossing either cap/free-space floor; preserve incomplete data and do not enlarge budgets silently
resource_bounds.retention: one existing Release directory reused in place, Debug kept for correctness. No per-stream build pairs, cache purge or automatic deletion of old evidence. Scope registry records ineligible earlier preparation outputs.

private_by_default: loaded module maps, actual argv/env and process/window IDs
all screenshots/window captures until explicit public review
evidence_publication_policy.private_storage: owned directories0700, files0600, umask077, reject symlinks/out-of-root paths; no credentials or unrelated-window capture; no automatic public dump of runtime context
public_whitelist: public generated fixture IDs and canonical byte/recipe hashes
curated repository-relative source/config paths, commits, tool versions and selected platform descriptors
opaque sample/cell ordinals and relative phase offsets
aggregate metrics, bounds, eligibility counts and explicit limitations
source-audited preparation isolation contract with owned paths; no inherited environment values
public_exclusions: raw inherited environment or auth paths/tokens
private geometry or other application windows
evidence_publication_policy.fixture_vs_runtime: Public generated geometry does not make runtime provenance public. Publish only a separate schema-whitelisted sanitized artifact after privacy review; redacted raw evidence remains private.

preview_oracle.commands: PartDesign interactive pattern/fillet/chamfer and PartDesign::Boolean TypeCut/Fuse with Tool body Group; source references FeatureBoolean.cpp/updatePreviewShape and ViewProviderBoolean.cpp plus FeatureTransformed.cpp
preview_oracle.timings: Emit separate preview-complete and accept-to-correct-result durations for every F01 attempt; never collapse to one aggregate number or add inclusive overlaps.
preview_oracle.candidate_geometry: Underlying proposed feature result must satisfy the same analytic dimensions/volume/topology/reference contract as accepted geometry. Preview visible scene may use source-defined base/tool or removed/added material overlays, not falsely interpreted as the final accepted mesh. T002 maps frozen semantic roles to actual scene nodes.

known_boolean_preview_roles.Cut: removed intersection volume2400, original base and tool20x20x12 at(W-10,20,0) as source-defined overlays; final result Vbase-2400
known_boolean_preview_roles.Fuse: tool-compound overlay volume4800 with original base and known intersection2400; final result Vbase+2400

preview_oracle.transaction: Preview is an owned uncommitted transaction/candidate; canonical original unchanged. Normal transient view/model events are allowed, but persistent authored properties/tip/references cannot be committed before Accept.
preview_oracle.cancel_gate: T002 qualifies preview→cancel/teardown→baseline for every F01 cell: original authored geometry/properties/tip/links/selection/transaction state restored, no leftover feature/preview nodes or subscription/queued residue; source-defined nonsemantic cache/counter differences explicitly identified, never used to hide authored change.
preview_oracle.accept_gate: After preview Accept commits exactly the intended feature; accepted shape/reference/error and undo/redo oracle must pass. No preview/cancel measurement is claimed from fixture preparation.

near_rank_coverage_gate.candidate: Q-near-tangent is analytically ill-conditioned (kappa1e5 baseline/5e4 action), NOT yet proven close to either native rank threshold. Q-near-axis is not a substitute.
near_rank_coverage_gate.T002_requirement: Source-confirm both methods rank tolerances and native Jacobian scaling; map singular-value ratio and independent analytic/native matrix oracle. Require the near-rank cell to lie within0.1x..10x of at least one relevant effective numerical cutoff under frozen settings; do not modify those settings.
near_rank_coverage_gate.if_not_sensitive: No nearly-rank-deficient coverage claim or Q01 study freeze. Prospectively amend T001 with an actually threshold-sensitive specimen/oracle, new canonical hash and schedule before Q01 samples; never relabel or tune cutoffs to manufacture it.

canonical_hash_serialization: SHA256 over UTF-8 json.dumps(value,sort_keys=True,separators=(",",":"),ensure_ascii=True), no trailing LF for recipe/oracle/schedule hashes. File SHA covers exact bytes including existing LF.
T002_required_study_freeze: build current Release source in place and verify compiler/options/source-to-binary receipt
actual executable/all selected ELF/Python/driver/loaded module maps with user-site isolation proof
actual worker argv/environment/namespaces/process/display/viewport and capability-permission smoke tests
materialized derived work copies/checkpoints and reset, numerical/geometry/reference/assembly/tree oracle qualification
source-proven QR selection + observed per-run method, J/JT references and settings restoration
source-proven frame/pick/preview/solve endpoints, input pacing/admission and narrower presentation fallback
instrumentation/telemetry overhead, clocks, bounds, cleanup and final immutable study-freeze hashes
amendment_rule: T001 freezes semantic inputs/schedules/oracles/budgets. T002 may realize only the explicit frozen endpoint fallback menu and adapters; any different fixture/operation/oracle/schedule/cache/build mode/exclusion/resource policy needs a prospective T001 revision and new identity. Actual binary/probe changes require fresh affected T002 qualification. No sample is eligible from T001 inventory alone.
